_comment: Reference configuration for the two ARCA services. Railway is configured through its dashboard; this file records what those settings should be so they are reviewable in git. See docs/07-deployment-railway.md.

deploy._comment: numReplicas must stay 1. The event bus is in-process and the watcher assumes a single watermark holder; two instances would double-submit simulations against DeepFire's two-in-flight budget.
NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_URL is baked in at build time. Changing it needs a redeploy, not a restart.
